next_question.rationale: The largest loss is between started an order and paid and confirmed (417,569 lost). Orders that need a prescription often add steps (book/complete a consultation, upload/accept a prescription) that can stop conversion; I expect carts requiring a prescription will convert materially worse than non-prescription carts and explain a meaningful share of the 417,569 lost. Confirming this points the fix at consultation flow or prescription gating rather than payments or delivery.
